rawProofCommandBoundary: Hermetic in-memory proof only. It exercises the USF jobs and enterprise workflow control planes with synthetic tenants, synchronous PDP decisions, value-free audit evidence, and no live Temporal, Windmill, external queue, scheduler, worker cluster, or production substrate.
nonClaims: No full dev readiness, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, deployment readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, enterprise production readiness, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.
Hermetic jobs/workflows proof does not prove live Temporal, live Windmill, external queue, scheduler, worker cluster, operator automation readiness, or production automation readiness.
Local workflow-control evidence does not prove API/HTTP job surfaces, operator console UI, live metrics/alerting, production incident response, or environment promotion.
Temporal and Windmill remain provider/substitute boundaries behind USF ports; no capability imports provider SDKs.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Each deferred jobs/workflows control is implemented with proof or explicitly reclassified.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: Controls below record bounded-local-proof for workflow version/replay/migration, outbox/inbox, quota/backpressure, pause/resume/drain, backup/restore/replay posture, dry-run/impact gate, heartbeat/concurrency, high-risk automation, and egress/circuit breaker; live provider, HTTP API, cron tenant-local schedules, and operator automation readiness remain deferred or reclassified with explicit boundaries.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Workflow provider and operator automation substitute boundaries are explicit.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: temporal-durable-workflow-boundary and windmill-operator-automation-boundary rows record non-equivalence boundaries and service catalogue traceability without live provider or readiness claims.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Tenant, access, audit, retry, cleanup, and fail-closed evidence exists where claimed.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: make jobs-proof records enterpriseWorkflowEvidence flags for tenantBoundaryChecked, accessBoundaryChecked, auditEvidenceCaptured, retryTimeoutCleanupFailClosedChecked, and providerSubstituteBoundaryChecked; tests/capabilities/jobs-workflows.test.ts covers high-risk authorization and fail-closed paths.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Validator coverage exists for any new workflow claim.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: USF-JOBS-021 through USF-JOBS-025 validate the enterprise control-plane helper, proof markers, matrix completeness, enterprise evidence rows, PDP/admin override coupling, and prohibited readiness claims.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: No live workflow or production automation claim is made without proof.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: claims object and proof result set liveWorkflowReadinessClaim, operatorAutomationReadinessClaim, workerClusterReadinessClaim, productionReadinessClaim, SOC readiness, ISO certification, full-dev, full-parity, and USF-133 closure claims to false.
